book.title: Mataio Iesu Keriso Hari Manoḡa Mataioꞌa Mirihiro

content: Ioane Babatiso Maro
Eꞌe madaḡano Galilea habaꞌa kiniḡa, Herodaꞌa Iesu hariḡa igiro.
Ebu aniꞌa ane gau azaḡa ziro, “Iesuꞌe Ioane Babatiso. Aneꞌa rune azaḡa boꞌaḡano bare ḡabodeha. ꞌOugadu aneꞌa haḡai gigiꞌa inaraḡa hina gaueꞌohe.”
Ibite Herodaꞌa negoḡa Filipi inuga, niḡa Herodia uꞌano, Ioane obone teadu ḡuꞌa neḡano ohoniro.
Mazaḡa Ioaneꞌa Heroda mazao ꞌahige barebare niro, “Ḡaꞌa negoḡo inuga meirotaꞌaꞌe mene idaḡa.”
Herodaꞌa Ioane matihi reiro, rehano aniꞌe vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa rihoziro, mazaḡa zeꞌe Ioaneꞌe peroveta vazeḡa rae mae ḡihiniro.
Herodaꞌa fureraroteꞌe madaḡa meirotene, Heroda aboḡaniꞌa vaze ḡehaḡa zamao zavonadu Heroda zama ufeta matuꞌoharo.
Eꞌanoꞌo Herodaꞌa ani teite ꞌahige ḡoitoradu ane ḡoere rinede tiro, “Ḡaeꞌa nagini umidine zuni, eḡeꞌa ḡaniꞌuma.”
Ebu aniꞌa viꞌa ḡoere egadu Heroda niro, “Ioane Babatiso vadiniꞌe siuva rana teadu izidi ꞌada enoꞌi.”
ꞌOugadu Heroda zamaḡaniꞌa adudaro. Rehano ani aneꞌa huziroteꞌe azaḡa zamao ane ḡoere rinede tiro ꞌahine, ani uti azaḡa mazao aboḡaniꞌa urateꞌeteꞌe ḡauḡa hanoꞌi rae ziro.
Eꞌanoꞌo aniꞌa uti azaḡa tuḡuzadu ḡuꞌa neḡano Ioane Babatiso ꞌunu variꞌe riꞌiro.
Ebu vadigaꞌe siuva rana teadu odohe ariro ebu roḡae tahiꞌaḡa hanadu aneꞌa viꞌa haro.
Ebu Ioane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa aradu ane ahiri meiro ebu guriro. Eꞌe enogano zeꞌe Iesu vaḡe onamadu Ioane rune hariḡa meꞌodoharo.
Vaze 5,000 Ḡubuziro
Iesuꞌa Ioane hariḡa igirotene, eꞌe habaꞌa modadu ḡasi hina vaze oꞌoꞌa habaꞌa sifu ruhau onamiro. Rehano vaze ḡuḡuvaḡaniꞌa eꞌe egadu nezeonoꞌo odao Iesu hegote onamiro.
Iesuꞌa ḡasionoꞌo buanadu vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa horozirotene, vetuḡazeadu ugi azaḡa faiziro.
Ḡoravararotene, ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa Iesu vaḡe aradu niro, “ꞌAhiꞌe haba bohaꞌa ebu mada ꞌai zubureha. Eꞌanoꞌo vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa ꞌadi tuḡuze vaḡizoꞌi. ꞌOugine, ze neḡaneḡa onamadu ogomuze hoitiꞌuma.”
Rehano aniꞌa naenaeziro, “Ze mene onamiꞌuma, rehano zaeꞌa ogomu nu zenoꞌi.”
Zeꞌa niro, “Eme mazaoꞌe ꞌuvahu odoga fuꞌo zu ḡozone aheu daꞌo.”
Aniꞌa ziro, “Eḡe vaḡe mae aroꞌi.”

Ebu aniꞌa vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa ve rana ehoroga radu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ziro. Ebu aniꞌa ꞌuvahu odoga fuꞌo zu ḡozone aheu madu adure ite ḡianeꞌenaꞌa, Badiꞌa mazao manoḡa tauḡi reiro. Ebu vahege tahitahadu ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa ziniro, ebu zeḡeꞌa vaze niduꞌa ḡahugo ziniro.
ꞌOugadu zeḡe niduꞌa au ubararo, ebu Iesu tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌa ogomu ḡahaꞌaḡahaꞌaꞌe nuꞌonadu tunahu niduꞌa gaubanana aheu fare iriꞌavoniro.
Eꞌea ogaroteꞌe azaḡa boꞌaḡano ohoze niduꞌa daꞌoꞌe 5,000, ebu roḡaeroḡae zu tahiꞌa komeꞌakomeꞌa ḡehaḡa zuni aro.
Vu rana Onamiro
Iesuꞌa zogone ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa tuḡuze ḡasio tiriro ebu ziro, “Eḡe vitihe duꞌura moneafa fare onamoꞌi.” U Iesuꞌe vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa tuḡuziro.
Iesuꞌe vaze ḡuḡuvaḡa tuḡuze hauḡiroteꞌe enogano, ane daꞌo maḡa komeꞌa itadu kuraro. Ḡoravararotene, eꞌea ane daꞌo radiunu.
Eꞌe madaḡano ḡasizeꞌe hesaonoꞌo fararo ebu zavara boroboroꞌa ariro ꞌahine, saꞌu boroꞌa ragatadu ḡasize ḡihuḡihuniro.
Iraranae reirotene, Iesuꞌa vu rana ragaveꞌenaꞌa, ane tahiꞌatahiꞌa vaḡe onamiro.
Ane tahiꞌatahiꞌaꞌe Iesuꞌa vu rana edau ariroteꞌe horonirotene, rihau rudanadu huau ḡaniḡanaro, “Aꞌe vine!”
Rehano Iesuꞌa zogone ziro, “Zamaze rinedoꞌi! ꞌAdiꞌe eḡe. Ago rihanoꞌi.”
Peteroꞌa niro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, a hube hune ḡa roꞌidene, eḡe zuni vu rana ḡae vaḡe amoga veize huhoꞌi.”
Iesuꞌa niro, “Aroꞌi.” Ebu Peteroꞌa ḡasionoꞌo buanadu vu rana Iesu vaḡe edau onamiro.
Rehano aniꞌa zavara boro horonirotene, rihanadu vu zamaḡa zubure ovoiro ebu ḡaniḡanaro, “Zuhiꞌa Boro, e ḡabohoꞌi!”
Iesuꞌa zogone ꞌevoꞌa ꞌeinadu ani abine ḡihiniro ebu niro, “Ḡaꞌe mene gigaru fieꞌeteꞌe vazeḡa! Nougadu ꞌadaꞌadeha?”
Anianine ḡasio tirirotene, zavara ꞌai dauḡiro.
Ebu ḡasi zamaḡa azaḡaꞌe Iesu mazao kuraro ebu niro, “Hube hune ḡaꞌe Badiꞌa Ubuga.”
Ugi Azaḡa Faiziro
Zeꞌa duꞌura faradu Genesareta habaꞌano hebetiro.
Haba eꞌe azaḡaniꞌa Iesuꞌa ariroteꞌe ederadu ne uhiḡauhiḡa azaḡa niduꞌa veize ḡoere tuḡuriro. Ebu ze ugi azaḡa niduꞌa Iesu vaḡe tutuze ariro.
Ebu ugi azaḡaꞌe Iesu dabuaḡa ꞌariḡa tahiḡano daꞌo obonoga veize Iesu uminiro. ꞌOugadu oboniroteꞌe azaḡa niduꞌaꞌe ugizeꞌa manoriro.
